reviewItem.question: Does "Upgrade procedure: :warning: The Flux APIs `v1beta1` and `v2beta1` (deprecated in 2023) have reached end-of-life and have been removed from the CRDs" mean a change to migration:flux|name=flux-migrate (migration-required)?

proposed.statement: Flux APIs v1beta1 and v2beta1 were removed from the CRDs; unless Flux Operator deploys the controllers, `flux migrate` must be run on clusters before upgrading to 2.7.
